title: Find and remove the cause of the longer verifier stage
summary: The verifier stage median rose from 3.1 to 3.5 min per landed job. The producer finds the cause in the verifier path, fixes it so the stage gets shorter, and states the cause in a docs/design note. The audience is the maintainer reading the next throughput review.

defaults_applied.how: The cause must be found and removed, not hidden.
The criteria check the fix and a test, not just that files exist.
The goal is that verifier minutes fall.
The design note is written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/status.rs. It defines the stage medians (the verifier column is role_minutes over Role::Verifier, around lines 651-931), and `athena status` prints them. The producer must also survey the verifier run path in crates/athena-core/src/run/ and the checks the verifier runs, to find where time is spent. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not affected.
The verifier time is measured directly by role_minutes on the verifier invocations, not through a stand-in.
Cause is not yet known. The producer must measure it from the code (for example repeated or cold builds, redundant checks, a larger prompt or diff context for the verifier) and not guess.
The change makes no new refusal rule, so no refused-reading percentage applies.
Out of scope: rewording the other stages, and changing records/ or the throughput review thresholds.

acceptance_criteria.text: A note under docs/design/ (or the commit message) states the cause of the longer verifier stage and cites the code path or measurement that shows it, and the verifier can read it in the diff.
The diff removes the stated cause in crates/ code in the verifier path, for example by removing redundant work, and does not only change how the median is reported.
Run `cargo test` from the repository root: it passes, including a new or updated test that exercises the changed verifier behavior, and it fails if the cause is reintroduced.
Run `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.
The change is a single focused fix with no unrelated edits, and the note says how the next throughput review should show verifier minutes per landed job falling below 3.5.

out_of_scope: Changes to the other stages' timing
Changes to records/ or to the throughput review thresholds
departures: The cause is unknown and the fix is not verifiable by running a throughput review, so I lowered the pass probability slightly.
urgent_reason: The request is a throughput regression, and the fix cuts verifier time per landed job.
